definitions.explanation: A solid figure with a triangular base and triangular side faces meeting at a single apex.

examples.japanese: この{置物|おきもの}は{三角錐|さんかくすい}の{形|かたち}だ。
examples.english: This ornament is shaped like a triangular pyramid.

examples.japanese: {三角錐|さんかくすい}の{体積|たいせき}を{求|もと}めなさい。
examples.english: Find the volume of the triangular pyramid.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{紙|がみ}できれいな{三角錐|さんかくすい}を{作|つく}るのは{意外|いがい}と{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Making a neat triangular pyramid out of origami is surprisingly difficult.

notes:
Composed of {三角|さんかく} (triangle) + {錐|すい} (a pyramid or cone solid). A basic shape in school geometry.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {円錐|えんすい}: cone — has a circular base
- {四角錐|しかくすい}: square pyramid — has a square base
- {角錐|かくすい}: pyramid — the general term for a solid with a polygonal base
